subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up / token volumes
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@acmelabs.com>
Cc: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acmelabs.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: model mix & next steps (token volumes + budget)

Hi Alex / Jamie,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — really useful conversation. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put together a tailored pricing/architecture note: 

- Use case summary: customer support automation + semantic search for internal KBs. Primary surface: chat (agent assist) + embeddings for semantic search + occasional reranking for high-value search results.
- Expected latency SLOs: P95 < 400ms for agent responses.
- Security: likely Dedicated or Private (we discussed VPC options).

To get you an accurate cost estimate we need: 
1) Monthly token volumes broken down by model type (chat vs embeddings vs rerank). If you only have session counts, an approximate tokens/session is fine.
2) Target monthly budget range for inference (ballpark is fine, e.g., $5k-$20k/month).
3) Priority model mix (which do you want to optimize for: cost vs quality vs latency).

If you can drop the numbers in a quick reply I’ll run a model-mix unit economics calc and propose a target $/1M tokens and recommended Redwood config (hosted vs dedicated, batching/kv cache settings, and quantization options).

I attached a simple token estimate template (acme_token_estimates.xlsx) and our summary pricing options (redwood_pricing_options.pdf) to make this quick.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@acmelabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acmelabs.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model mix & next steps (token volumes + budget)

Thanks Marissa — great demo. Below are our rough numbers (this is a cross-functional estimate; I can follow up with engineering if you need more granularity):

- Estimated monthly active users (sessions): 40k sessions/month
- Average chat length: 250 tokens/request, ~1.8 requests/session => ~450 tokens/session => ~18M chat tokens/month
- Embeddings: ~100k vector requests/month, avg 512 tokens/context => ~51.2M embedding tokens/month (we vectorize longer docs)
- Rerank: ~20k calls/month, avg 120 tokens => ~2.4M rerank tokens/month

Rough monthly totals: chat ~18M tokens, embeddings ~51.2M tokens, rerank ~2.4M tokens => ~71.6M tokens/month total.

Budget: we are initially targeting $10k-$15k/month for inference (pilot). If unit economics scrub differently we'll escalate.

Priority: quality for chat (agent assist) is highest, then embeddings relevance, rerank is lower volume but used for certain flows. Latency matters for chat (P95 target).

Happy to jump on a quick call if you want me to walk through the calc.

Best,
Alex
Head of Product, Acme Labs
alex.reed@acmelabs.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reed <alex.reed@acmelabs.com>
Cc: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acmelabs.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model mix & pricing follow-up

Appreciate the detail, Alex — this is exactly what we need. A couple quick clarifying Qs before I run the model-mix unit economics: 

1) For embeddings, when you say 512 tokens/context are you including the full document plus metadata? Are you using chunking today or sending full documents?
2) For chat: can you confirm the split between synchronous user-facing messages vs background agent-assist completions (both count as tokens but have different latency tolerance). Even a rough split like 70/30 is helpful.
3) Any expected growth over the next 3 months (factor) so we can include headroom in the pricing proposal?

I'll run 2 scenarios once I have those (pilot volumes and 3-month growth + predictable Dedicated sizing). I’ll also include a target $/1M tokens and suggested model mix with cost/year estimates. CCing Logan from Solutions to validate latency/architecture recommendations on our end.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Alex Reed <alex.reed@acmelabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acmelabs.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:09:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: model mix & pricing follow-up

Hey Marissa — quick answers:

1) Embeddings: we currently chunk longer docs into ~512 token chunks before vectorizing (so the 512 is per chunk).
2) Chat split: ~65% user-facing synchronous messages, ~35% agent-assist (background) completions.
3) Growth: expect ~1.2x over 3 months if pilot goes well.

Happy with the plan — would love the target $/1M tokens and a recommended leaning (e.g., mix of open LLM chat models + a higher-quality chat model for specific flows).

Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Alex Reed <alex.reed@acmelabs.com>, Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acmelabs.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: pricing calc request + suggested target $/1M tokens (please review)

Logan / Vivek — flagging the Acme thread. They reported ~71.6M tokens/mo and $10k-$15k target for pilot. Priorities: quality for chat, embeddings high volume, rerank small. Growth ~1.2x over 3 months.

I attached the token template. Can you please run a quick unit-econ calc and recommend: 
- target $/1M tokens we could reasonably hit for pilot (hosted) while meeting quality targets
- suggested model mix (chat model A: 40%, chat model B: 25%, embeddings model C: 30%, rerank small model 5%) OR alternatives if Dedicated gets better unit economics
- recommended configuration: hosted vs dedicated, batching/kv cache suggestions, and any upsell for SLA/private deployment given security notes

Goal: get a short proposal back to Alex by EOD with 2 scenarios (hosted pilot pricing and Dedicated committed pricing).

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
